summary: One-line fix swaps `repr(text)` for `str(text)` so Decimal inputs are parsed directly into Decimal instead of falling through to lossy float conversion, correctly resolving the precision-loss bug. Minimal, correct, and no regression for float inputs since `str` and `repr` of floats are identical in Python 3.

issues.description: No inline comment explaining why `str` is required over `repr` (Decimal round-trip preservation). A one-line note would prevent a future contributor from 'restoring' repr, but this is optional and non-blocking.
